snippet.title: Sifu | Official Launch Trailer | PS4, PS5 & PC
snippet.description:
Sifu launches today! It is time to reveal the violent spark that has laid our main character on their path of revenge. They took everything from you, and now the time for vengeance has finally come. Are you up for the task? 

Sifu is available now!
Playstation Store : https://store.playstation.com/concept/10001973/
Epic Games Store : https://www.epicgames.com/store/en-US/p/sifu
